nodes.label: Tape
nodes.rationale: The append-only recording of a run; the project namesake and its source of truth.

nodes.label: Step
nodes.rationale: One round of ask-the-model then run-what-it-asked. The unit the tape is made of.

nodes.label: Canonical Event
nodes.rationale: The provider-neutral form a message takes on the tape; never one vendor's wire format.

nodes.label: Opaque Payload
nodes.rationale: Content the runtime cannot interpret. Stored verbatim, tagged with its provider, handed back untouched, dropped visibly on cross-provider fork.

nodes.label: Step Key
nodes.rationale: Fingerprint of a step. Change anything and every step from there misses the cache; every step before hits.

nodes.label: Replay
nodes.rationale: Re-running from the tape as a simulation: cached write results are returned without touching the world.

nodes.label: Resume
nodes.rationale: Re-executing for real against the workspace as it is. Not the same as replay.

nodes.label: Fork
nodes.rationale: A new run sharing history with an old one up to a chosen step. The cheap way to A/B a prompt change.

nodes.label: Divergence
nodes.rationale: Where a replay stops matching and goes live.

nodes.label: Seam
nodes.rationale: A deliberate interface where one implementation can be swapped for another. There are four.

nodes.label: Conformance Suite
nodes.rationale: The tests that define what a ModelClient is. The Protocol is the signature; the suite is the contract.

nodes.label: Effect Class
nodes.rationale: Whether a tool changes the world. Replay soundness depends entirely on this.

nodes.label: Tool Pack
nodes.rationale: A registry of related tools built by a factory function, bound to a workspace.

nodes.label: Ship Criterion
nodes.rationale: An observable fact that ends a milestone, never a feeling. Several are executable tests.

nodes.label: Architecture Decision Record
nodes.rationale: Numbered, dated, immutable. A changed decision gets a new ADR marking the old superseded.

nodes.label: Harness / Runtime
nodes.rationale: The code around the model that actually runs things. Not the model.

nodes.label: Tool Schema
nodes.rationale: Machine-readable description of a tool. Generated here from type hints rather than hand-written.
